# Several constructs interacting. The one file allowed to be messy.

# Service config: block mappings, flow collections that reflow, an anchor,
# a block scalar, comments in two positions.

name: edge-proxy
revision: 17
listen: { host: 0.0.0.0, port: 8443 } # inline on a root pair
features: [http2, gzip, access-log, proxy-protocol, tls-session-tickets]

upstream:
  primary: &origin
    url: https://origin.example.com/api/v1
    timeout: 30
    headers: { authorization: Bearer placeholder, accept: application/json }
    tls:
      alpn: [h2, http/1.1]
      sni: origin.example.com
  canary:
    <<: *origin
    weight: 5
    url: https://canary.example.com/api/v1

middlewares:
  - name: ratelimit
    params: { requests: 100, window: 1m, burst: 20 }
  - name: rewrite
    # comment attached to the next pair, not the header
    paths: [/v1, /v2, /internal/healthz, /internal/readyz, /metrics]
  - name: auth
    skip: true

logging:
  level: info
  format: |
    {timestamp} {level} {target}
    {message}
# trailing comment at the end of the kitchen
